chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: The bus breaks down in Lee County, Florida
summary: After mentioning Chris Goddard of London, Fields tells of a water pump failing in Florida and eating at a roadside cafe.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: I would tell you one incident that happened, but you may know the gentleman, he was from London, who interviewed me, and it looked like he was interested in everything that did happen bad and I'll tell you about one little incident.
Who was the gentleman from London?
Is he mentioned in this guideline?

Anyway, Melvin had a very nice sense of humor, very intelligent and smart but he was a kidder, if one of the driver's or valets asked Melvin for a wrench, he'd say, what do you think we're paying you for, I'm a vocalist, don't ask me for nothing; and kid. So I was in Florida, somewhere in Florida, and my radiator, a water pump or something, went on the bus, and it began to leak very bad and we had to stop at every little mud hole and put water in, so I got to a little town that was nothing but a stop and go and decided I better not go any further, get this thing fixed because I didn't want to mess my motor up. So I went into this filling station and there was a cafe adjoining it, and I asked if there was a mechanic and he said no, but what's the trouble and I told him. He said down the road about three miles is a one stop garage that can fix practically anything, but I'm the only one here now, but when my partner comes back, you can go there. I said I don't want to drive my

bus any farther. He said I'll tow you down there after my partner comes back, but I can't leave now because there's nobody but me. So I said okay, I'll wait then. He said yes. So we went outside the station and I went in this little cafe part and asked the lady in there could we get service and she said yes and I said can we eat in here and she said why, sure. I guess she judged how many we were and she wasn't going to miss that nice treat and so before she said anything, I said can we wash up. You know how they used to be about the restrooms and she told us yes.
